_comment: P-017A same-direction maker — KILL. Does resting a YES bid at the pre-tournament anchor beat lifting the ask, once non-fill is paid for? No: Delta = -6.59c per posted market per intended contract, CI [-9.24,-4.03], 11/12 tournaments negative. KILL on BOTH pre-registered triggers independently (contract fill fraction 2.2% < 25% floor; Delta <= -1.0c with CI excluding zero). All 18 grid cells negative with CI excluding zero; best cell anywhere -5.13c. The 1.04c taker fee is worth paying and this question is CLOSED. Pre-declared in golf_research/P017_MAKER_PREDECLARATION.md (commit 927555f) before any effect number. Full detail: golf_research/REPORT_P017_Maker_2026-07-30.md; raw grid: p017_maker_results.json.

universe._band_note: The SHIPPED band, per p017_params.json leg_A_pre_tourn_taker.
universe._n_reproduces: Matches the published n=1149 at the 0.08-0.45 band EXACTLY — the Leg A rule is reproduced, not approximated.
universe._scalar_note: ZERO scalar rows in the admissible universe, so settlement is binary $1/$0 and is identical across both arms. Independently confirms the p017_params.json note that scalar does not touch this leg.

design._quote_size_note: Intended size, IDENTICAL in both arms. A research cap, NOT a live sizing recommendation.
design._primary_definition: Delta = sum_m [ net_maker(m) - net_taker(m) ] / (Q * posted_markets), in cents. Per POSTED market, not per filled contract: a maker that earns more on its fills is still worse if it forgoes the taker's edge on everything it misses.
design.pairing: WITHIN-MARKET. Both arms computed on the same market from the same anchor candle. Leg A's own CI spans 5.6c and cannot resolve a ~1c effect by differencing two independent means.
design.bootstrap: 5000 resamples, clustered by TOURNAMENT, seed 12345 (quirks_common.bootstrap_unweighted; every market carries identical intended size Q, so equal weighting IS contract weighting).
design.taker_arm: buy Q at the anchor ASK, pay taker fee 0.07*P*(1-P)
design.maker_arm: rest a bid for Q at the anchor BID, fill only on taker_side='no' prints strictly through, maker fee 0.0
design._primary_window: Post at the anchor observation; cancel at close - 96h, the far edge of Leg A's own 4-10 day window. Median ~19.7h of resting time; the quote NEVER rests inside the tournament, which is what keeps this a one-variable experiment. Resting past 96h is Leg B's question.

result_primary._maker_net_on_fills_warning: THE SEDUCTIVE NUMBER. +13.69c/ct looks superb but is 30 markets and 2.2% of the capital, alongside Delta = -6.59c. Reporting per-contract-on-fills alone would have INVERTED this verdict. Secondary, never headline.
result_primary.tournaments_negative: 11/12 (TRAV26 the lone positive at +4.84c — the same signature-event week that is Leg A's lone negative)

grid_summary._best_cell: mid-0.00_cancel48h_atOrThrough — the friendliest convention in the grid, still -5.13c with CI [-7.31,-3.01].
grid_summary._no_cherry_pick: Full grid reported in the report; no cell was selected after the fact. The primary cell was fixed in the pre-declaration.

price_advantage_is_real.decomposition: taker fee at the mean admissible ask (0.1909) = 1.08c; mean ask-to-bid distance = 1.54c; total 2.62c = fee + spread.
price_advantage_is_real._predeclared_ceiling_check: The pre-declaration predicted fee + spread ~= 2.1c and set the look-ahead alarm at Delta > +2.2c. Measured 2.62c lands within 0.05c of a from-first-principles recomputation, so there is NO look-ahead in the fill logic.

failure_1_cannot_fill.note: With a +2.62c per-filled gain against a forgone +7.14c on every unfilled contract, Delta >= 0 needs phi ~ 77%. Four to five days pre-tournament almost nobody sells through the bid on a 19c top-20 name.

failure_2_fills_cost_adverse_selection.note: The ONLY lever that raises phi is resting longer, which walks the quote into the tournament where the informed side hits it. The two failure modes are mutually reinforcing: you buy fills with adverse selection at roughly the rate that cancels them out.

why_it_fails.leg_b_repeating: YES — named explicitly per the pre-declaration. At cancel 0h the FILLED cohort settles at 0.186 vs 0.270 posted (a 31% relative haircut) and the maker's edge on its own fills goes NEGATIVE. Same mechanic as Leg B (opposite side of the book) and as the make-cut study (0.361 vs 0.558). A resting quote on a market that trades through its own determining period is a one-way option written to the informed side, and the DIRECTION of the quote does not change that.

anchor_contemporaneity.verdict: CLEAN. Both arms transact at the anchor instant (post_at_anchor=True), so staleness is SHARED and cannot bias Delta. No repeat of the make-cut study's median-68h-stale +9.5c artifact.

selection_866_vs_1149.cause: The tick tape was pulled under the P-023c screen (anchor at 48h within 0.08-0.45), NOT Leg A's 4-10 day screen. A missing tape file does NOT mean the market never traded — it chiefly means the name had drifted out of the band by tournament start.
selection_866_vs_1149.verdict: The intersection is MILDLY UNFAVOURABLE to the taker baseline, i.e. slightly generous to the maker — it strengthens the KILL rather than threatening it. Pairing is within-market regardless, so Delta is insulated.

declared_checks.taker_fill_assumption: The taker's 100% fill is an ASSUMPTION (Leg A models no fill risk), generous to the taker, and therefore a genuine limitation of a KILL. It does not rescue the result: closing a 6.6c gap needs the live taker to miss ~half its intended size, and the phi < 25% trigger fires independently of Delta.
declared_checks.fees: src/kalshi_fees.fee_per_contract with series_ticker passed. Taker 0.07*P*(1-P); maker 0.0 for KXPGATOP10/KXPGATOP20 (quadratic, resolved through the generated fixture). Nothing hard-coded, INCLUDING the zero.

harness_provenance.no_third_harness: quirks_common.replay() ALREADY implemented side='buy_yes'. No inversion of the sell-side logic was required.
additive_changes: quote_px_by_ticker — per-market quote price ('rest at the anchor BID' cannot be expressed as a scalar offset off the anchor mid)
collect_per_market — per-market fill detail, required to pair maker against taker on the same market
harness_provenance.inertness_verified: backtest_fade_fills.py --validate produces BYTE-IDENTICAL output before and after, confirmed by stashing the change and re-running. Both parameters default to prior behaviour.
harness_provenance.anchor_injection: Leg A's anchor candle is handed to replay as the market's sole candle, so the replay's internal anchor resolves to exactly the candle Leg A priced off and post_at_anchor=True posts at the moment Leg A transacted.

gate_reset_answer.question: Does changing execution mid-gate reset P-017's settled-tournament count?
gate_reset_answer._honest_answer: The locked documents do NOT state a reset rule explicitly. That should not be paraphrased into one.
gate_reset_answer.inference: They answer it by construction in two places: (1) P-017_Golf_Pod_Spec.md already treats the maker variant as a SEPARATE leg with its own gate ('P-017M validates on fill quality (>=30% of quoted names fill) AND positive markout-implied net'); (2) RESEARCH_TESTING_BRIEF_2026-07-26.md sec.4 makes pre-registering the forward gate before the first fill 'non-negotiable', and P-017's gate metric is denominated in half the TAKER backtest baseline. Read together: a maker switch is a new leg needing its own gate, i.e. the count would RESTART.
gate_reset_answer.status: INFERENCE, not a quoted rule. If Sam wants it binding it should be written into the spec.
gate_reset_answer.moot_here: Verdict is KILL, so nothing is proposed. Note also that at the primary cell this design fills 3.5% of quoted names and would fail P-017M's OWN >=30% fill-quality gate by an order of magnitude, independently of Delta.

brief_corrections.origin_report_missing: The brief cites fee_parabola_research/REPORT_Fee_Parabola_2026-07-28.md. No such file or directory exists in this repo and no commit references one. Its figures (1.20c/ct tape estimate, 13.3% of in-band volume filling a resting bid, +0.23c vs -1.41c by flow side) could not be verified and are NOT relied on. The 1.04c fee IS independently confirmed at 1.08c on the mean admissible ask.
brief_corrections.ceiling_was_too_low: The brief set the ceiling on Delta at +1.04c (the fee) and flagged >+1.5c as a look-ahead red flag. That holds only if the maker quotes at the TAKER's price; resting at the BID also captures the spread, so the per-filled-contract ceiling is fee + spread ~= 2.1c. The alarm was raised to +2.2c in the pre-declaration BEFORE any number was seen. This mattered: the measured price advantage is +2.62c/ct, which under the brief's threshold would have been mis-read as a bug rather than as the correct structural gain.

incidental_finding.cause: Cache growth: the cached universe is now 404 markets / 22 tournaments vs the published 364 / 19, so every published cell mismatches (H12 off+0.02: +2.6c [+0.1,+4.5] now vs +3.4c [+1.7,+5.1] published).
incidental_finding.impact: backtest_topn_fade_fills.py ABORTS on it ('ABORT: harness does not reproduce P-022. Trust nothing.') and is un-runnable without --skip-validate.
incidental_finding.not_caused_by_this_study: Confirmed by stashing the changes and re-running: identical failure.
incidental_finding.fix: Re-baseline the validation targets to the current cache, or restate the published figures at n=404. Separate triage.
